Wrote the reader record. Summary of what the pinned tree supports:

**Pinned state**: HEAD `2189378` is at `package.json:4` version 1.2.2 and no file under `src/` contains any `__proto__`/dangerous-key guard, so both published fixes are absent here.

**Independent traps found** (all evidenced from the pinned code):
- **T1 `deepFillIn`** (`src/object/deepFillIn.js:15-21`) — M2 twin of the deep-merge copy; looks safe because it only fills null slots, but the inherited `__proto__` slot resolves to `Object.prototype` (`isPlainObject.js:7`), so the recursion writes there.
- **T2 `deepMixIn`** (`src/object/deepMixIn.js:15-27`) — M4, the reported route; `copyProp` reads `this[key]` and recurses into `Object.prototype`.
- **T3 `set`/`namespace`** (`src/object/namespace.js:8-14`, `src/object/set.js:9`) — M1; path writer follows inherited `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` segments; a `__proto__`-only fix leaves `constructor.prototype` open.
- **T4 `get`/`has`/`unset`** (`src/object/get.js:10-15`, `unset.js:13`) — M3; the delete sink sits above the shared resolver, and its natural guard conflicts with `has(obj,'constructor')===true` (`tests/spec/object/spec-has.js:32`).
- **T5 clone/mix/merge** (`src/lang/deepClone.js:20-21`, `mixIn.js:24`, `merge.js:22-27`) — M2; re-parents only the returned object, never `Object.prototype`.

**Verdict**: usable, with the 4-trap design T1–T4 (deepseek-type T1/T3, mimo-type T4), 50 min effort. The main uncertainty, stated in `unverified`, is which twin the two advisories name: the fix commits aren't in the worktree, so the A=deepFillIn / B=deepMixIn mapping is inferred from the twin pattern.
